subject: Request: IR playbook and evidence bundle for SOC 2 audit
messages:
From: Jake Morrison <jake.morrison@fintechco.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.example.com
Cc: Sam Lee <sam.lee@auditco.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: IR playbook and evidence bundle for SOC 2 audit

Hi Aditya,

We’re starting our SOC 2 readiness review and AuditCo (cc’d) has asked for Redwood’s incident response playbook and a small sample of recent incident evidence to validate controls (detection, escalation, root-cause, and remediation). Specifically they requested: a copy of the current IRP, one redacted post-incident timeline, and a short list of artifacts showing evidence retention and audit logging.

Can you share the playbook and an evidence manifest we can point the auditors at? Also let me know if you can do a 30-min walkthrough next week for the audit team.

Thanks,
Jake Morrison
Head of InfoSec, FinTechCo
Jake.Morrison@fintechco.com

--
Attachment: request_scope.docx (stub)

From: aditya_rao@redwood.example.com
To: Jake Morrison <jake.morrison@fintechco.com>
Cc: Sam Lee <sam.lee@auditco.com>, monica_patel@redwood.example.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.example.com
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: IR playbook and evidence bundle for SOC 2 audit

Hi Jake — thanks for the heads up and for looping AuditCo.

We can provide the IR playbook and a limited evidence bundle for auditor review. I attached: Redwood_IR_Playbook_v2.1.pdf (redacted where necessary), an evidence_manifest_20261121.csv listing available artifacts, and a small forensics_timeline_draft.txt that summarizes a recent engagement (redacted PII).

I can do a 30-min walkthrough on Tue 2026-11-24 at 10am PT — does that work for your team? If not, propose two alternate times and I’ll coordinate.

Quick notes on scope and redaction: we will not share full packet captures or raw logs; instead we’ll provide signed manifests, truncated log extracts (with identifiers removed), retention policy records, and our IR ticket timeline exported from Jira. AuditCo: if you need a specific log slice or additional proofs (HSM/KMS audit entries, admin action logs), flag it in reply so we can pull it ahead of the call.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.example.com

--
Attachments: Redwood_IR_Playbook_v2.1.pdf (stub), evidence_manifest_20261121.csv (stub), forensics_timeline_draft.txt (stub)

Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 12:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: IR playbook and evidence bundle for SOC 2 audit

Aditya — looping in a couple quick operational items before we hand over artifacts to FinTechCo/AuditCo: 

- For the timeline draft: I trimmed all customer identifiers and replaced with redaction tokens. We should ensure the manifest references the retained object IDs (S3 keys) not raw filenames.
- For logs: Rishi, please prepare 90-day admin action logs and redact IPs per policy. AuditCo may ask for proof of deletion for older files — include the S3 lifecycle policy and delete markers.
- For the walkthrough: recommend running through the canary incident (May 2026) and the escalation path into PagerDuty + exec notify. Keep postmortem summary to 5 slides.

I’ll also prepare a short checklist of items that require additional approvals (HSM audit entries, full PCAPs).

—Monica
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: ir_handback_checklist.pdf (stub)

Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 08:17:00 -08:00

Thanks Aditya and team — receiving the files now. Quick follow-ups from AuditCo (Sam):

> 1) Can you confirm the exact S3 keys or object IDs for the log extracts so we can reference them in our evidence request?
> 2) For the May canary incident: do you have an executive notification timeline and the PJ ticket export we can include in the sample?
> 3) Would you be comfortable sharing a redacted memory dump as an example of forensic artifact? If not, a summarized artifact list is fine.

We’ll plan the walkthrough on Tue 11/24 10am PT unless you suggest otherwise.

—Jake

From: aditya_rao@redwood.example.com

Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: IR playbook and evidence bundle for SOC 2 audit

Thanks — quick answers and next steps: 

1) S3 object references: the evidence_manifest_20261121.csv includes the canonical object IDs (s3://redwood-evidence/prod/ir/2026/05/canary-incident-12345/*). For confidentiality we’ll provide pre-signed read-only links for AuditCo during the walkthrough rather than open access.

2) PJ (PagerDuty) export: attached a ticket_export_may2026.csv with the incident timeline and escalation chain. The exec-notify slip is included as a separate entry.

3) Memory dump: we cannot share raw memory dumps. Policy requires capture-to-forensic-lab with additional approvals. We’ll provide a redacted forensic summary and a checklist of artifacts instead — see forensics_timeline_draft.txt and the redaction notes in the playbook. If AuditCo requires a sample binary, we can coordinate a controlled transfer under an NDA and w/ legal sign-off.

I’ve added a short postmortem summary link and a Drive folder with the redacted artifacts here: https://drive.redwood.example.com/fintechco/irp-20261121 — please use the walkthrough session to review links; we’ll enable presigned links for the auditors then.

Walkthrough confirmed: Tue 2026-11-24 10:00am PT (invite will follow).

Appreciate the quick turnaround — we’ll keep the evidence bundle to a minimal set so AuditCo can complete the control checks without exposure to raw data.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
